title: Node disk pressure causing pod evictions
symptoms: Pods evicted with reason Evicted, message: The node was low on resource: ephemeral-storage
Image pull failures due to full disk
root_cause: Insufficient node disk size; container logs not rotated; unused images not garbage collected; large emptyDir volumes
workaround: Cordon and drain affected node; increase node disk in launch template; manual docker/containerd image prune
permanent_fix: Increase default node disk to 100GB+; enable log rotation (max-size 10m, max-file 3); configure kubelet imageGCHighThresholdPercent; set ephemeral-storage requests on pods

auto_healing.mechanism: Node Problem Detector + cluster autoscaler replaces unhealthy nodes; automated image GC cron

notes: Review emptyDir usage in application Helm charts
